name: Maulana Junayed Al Habib
contribution: He emerged as the BNP-alliance candidate in Brahmanbaria-2 and represented the alliance side of the 2026 race against Rumeen Farhana.
context: Brahmanbaria-2 contest within the 2026 parliamentary election.
impact: He was one of the local opposition-standard bearers where BNP-led and allied politics met independent competition.
highlight: The alliance candidate who turned the Brahmanbaria-2 race into a close contest.
